reason: The audit is free and sounds useful, but I'd be sending open PO lines and inventory from our Epicor system to a company I've never heard of, and my ERP partner would be the first call I make. Getting IT and legal to sign off on that in 30 days is not something I'd bet on.
objection: Who is behind this, what happens to our data after they process it, and why would I trust a startup's read on our supplier dates over what my buyers already see?
would_change_my_mind: An endorsement from our Epicor partner or a peer plant that has used it, plus a written data-handling and deletion commitment that legal will accept.
